string.name: desc
string.value: Recharges 1 unit of power at set intervals, and gives you a chance to recharge on hit or evade. Your stats will also increase, based on your current level of charge. This skill may use up power.

string.name: h
string.value: One power unit recharged every 4 sec, and #prop% chance to recharge one unit on hit/evade. #strR% all stats per extra power unit.
